visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor basketball gymnasium with polished wooden floors and a prominent red-painted key area. Three female players in white jerseys and three male players in blue and black jerseys are positioned on the court. A female player with a ponytail dribbles the ball and prepares for a three-point shot while the camera uses a medium-full shot to capture the setup. (2) The action transitions into high-speed game highlights with rapid cuts. A male player with a muscular build tries to defend a female player, but she executes a quick crossover. The lighting is flat and even across the court, highlighting the vibrant blue and red floor markings. The background features stadium seating and several banners hanging from the ceiling. (3) During the mid-game phases, the camera employs several zoom-ins and slow-motion effects to emphasize successful shots. A female player performs a layup while jumping high against a much taller opponent. Other players are seen in the background watching the play intensely. Text overlays showing scores frequently update at the top right corner. (4) The final sequence shows the female team celebrating on the court after a successful play. The camera captures a close-up of the scoreboard and then pans across the players' smiling faces. The setting remains the same indoor arena with consistent bright artificial lighting. The players shake hands and the video ends with a large graphic overlay centered on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a fast-paced, bass-heavy hip-hop beat featuring synthesizers. A male narrator provides high-energy commentary in Mandarin Chinese with frequent pitch inflections and rapid speech. The rhythmic thumping of a basketball hitting the wooden floor is audible and synchronized with the visuals. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition into a faster sequence of highlights. The narrator's voice remains dominant and energetic, shouting key player names as they score. The BGM maintains a steady 126 BPM tempo with a strong, driving beat. (3) During a slow-motion highlight, the music ducks slightly to allow a stylized 'swish' sound effect and an amplified 'thud' of the ball hitting the ground. The narrator pauses briefly before exploding into an excited description of a three-pointer. Faint crowd cheering and applause are audible in the background mix. (4) In the final phase, the BGM swells in volume before ending with a definitive electronic 'stinger' sound. The narrator concludes the play-by-play with a triumphant tone. A short, lighter synthesizer melody plays during the end graphic as the sound of a whistle blows to signal the end of the game match.
